title: DemoManifest
description: The frozen, reproducible record of the mined demo case (HAR-129 section 1). Written once after case mining and never edited; content_sha256 is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 canonical JSON of the document without the content_sha256 field and without the database-assigned ids (top-level account_id and opportunity_id, and in each events[] item state_diff_id and state_after.account_id / state_after.opportunity_id), so the same case hashes the same in any database; every other field, created_at included, is covered. Canonical JSON: object keys sorted by byte order at every level, arrays in their given order, no insignificant whitespace, numbers as written, strings with no HTML escaping (the characters < > & stay literal, unlike the default Go and JavaScript encoders), no trailing newline. `events` is the history through N-1 in real chronology (replay_position strictly increasing), each with the state it produced. The held-out event N is a separate field and carries only what the event is: no state snapshot, diff or material flag, because Event N must not be visible to the system before Play (any state for it is produced by Play itself). What mining expected of N lives in `selection_expectations`, a block no pipeline stage reads.

data_cutoff.description: Occurred-at of the last history event: the replay world is materialized through here.

events.description: Events 1..N-1 with the snapshot and material diff after each. The event_sequence_ids are events[].event.event_id followed by held_out_event.event_id.

held_out_event.description: Event N: replay_position is the last history position plus one (SQL CHECK). Its held-out id is held_out_event.event_id. It must pin payload_sha256 (SQL CHECK demo_manifests_held_out_payload_pinned): the digest of the payload the replay dataset holds for it, which Play verifies before releasing the event.

why_selected.description: Why this case and this event were chosen, in terms of the mined state transitions; never a hand-authored story.

selection_expectations.description: What case mining predicted Event N would change, kept for audit and for checking Play afterwards. It is not state: no pipeline stage, agent or surface reads it, and it must never be used to produce a snapshot or diff for N.

mining.description: How the case was found: how many account timelines were scanned and how the sequence scored.

manifestEvent.description: One history event with the state it produced: HeldOutEvent fields, the snapshot after it and the material diff it caused.

then.description: A material event names what it changed and points at its diff.
